description: The second metacarpal forms the long index column, aligning the hand with the forearm and giving artists a reliable axis when blocking gestures.

landmarks.name: Base of the second metacarpal
landmarks.desc: Wedge-shaped proximal expansion that receives major wrist tendons and stacks the index knuckle column.

landmarks.name: Radial surface
landmarks.desc: Lateral plane facing the thumb column, useful for sighting perspective through the hand.

landmarks.name: Dorsal crest
landmarks.desc: Sharp posterior ridge that creates a subtle highlight under stretched extensor tendons.
